title: Validate Transfer Request
description: Transfer to validate before executing it. The body is a strict whitelist - fields not listed here are rejected with 400.

Deriv-App-ID.description: Application identifier. Required for Personal Access Token (PAT) authentication; not required for OAuth Bearer tokens.

source_id.description: Identifier of the source account: the wallet UUID, or the platform account ID such as MTR5312343 when source_type is platform.

destination_id.description: Identifier of the destination account: the wallet UUID, or the platform account ID such as MTR5312343 when destination_type is platform.

amount.description: Transfer amount as a decimal string, zero or greater.

balance.description: Current spendable balance of the source account, in source_currency. Same format as amount. Used to check the account holds enough funds.

source_currency.description: Currency code of the source account.

destination_currency.description: Currency code of the destination account.

rate.description: Exchange rate as a positive decimal string. Required when source_currency and destination_currency differ; omit otherwise.

source_platform_name.description: Platform name. Send when source_type is platform.

destination_platform_name.description: Platform name. Send when destination_type is platform.
